query: Unlike earlier techniques, our combination of in situ cryo-ET with membranograms has enabled us to visualize the organization of PSII across multiple adjacent stacked thylakoids within native cells. We determined that PSII supercomplexes randomly overlap between appressed membranes, challenging the idea that thylakoid stacking is mediated by specific static interactions between LHCII or PSII proteins across the stromal gap.
